text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Rob Roy! Did you get a birthday 
present ready?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
About that... um. I-I'm so sorry, 
Sweep-san. Your birthday present is...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wha... D-Don't tell me you didn't prepare 
anything?! Even though it's the Great 
Witch's birthday?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's not it. I had a present ready, 
but... it got away."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What the! Making excuses like... wait, 
huh?! It ran away?! What's with that, is 
it a familiar or something?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's actually a grimoire. I 
happened upon it by chance at an old 
bookstore, though even I couldn't read the 
contents."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious string of characters... 
Illustrations like magic circles... That 
is without a doubt... a spellbook!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There's no way it could just vanish on its 
own... I'm sure it ran away! Maybe it 
teleported with magic!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The book cast magic on its own...?! 
That's terrible! Rob Roy, let's move! 
We're definitely going to track it down 
and make it mine!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Hehe, Sweep-san looks like she's 
having fun♪ It took a while to shape the 
letters, but I'm glad I did my best!)
